# betterado_workitemtrackingprocess_inherited_control (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `control_id` (String) The ID of the inherited control to customize.
- `group_id` (String) The ID of the group containing the control.
- `process_id` (String) The ID of the process.
- `work_item_type_id` (String) The ID (reference name) of the work item type.

### Optional

- `label` (String) Label for the control.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `visible` (Boolean) Whether the control should be visible.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
